svg.aria-label: DFIR-Nexus v2 Architecture and Data Flow

g.text: Deterministic N1–N8 Spine • Examiner Cockpit UI • Stage 0 Headless Collect • Cryptographic HITL Gate
Parses evidence into case extractions/ (no LLM in parse lane)
N3 Case Index (ES / CSV) & N4 Query Pack
• Scans extractions/ via Elasticsearch (nexus-es) or offline CSV
Returns bounded candidate hits with file:line audit citations
• Narrates N4 query hits only — never invents facts
Stages findings strictly as DRAFT awaiting human gate
Three Driving Modes (Same Spine & HMAC Lock):
Mode 1 (Examiner-Led): NL Query + RAG + Scribe (Public Beta)
• All AI findings stage as DRAFT
5. Case Persistence, Ingest Extensions & Detection Engineering
• Canonical Persistence: findings, evidence, timeline, TODOs
Tamper verification walks chain to detect unauthorized alterations
• Ingest Zeek, Suricata, EDR, SIEM, PCAP onto same case_id
• Merges network & cloud telemetry with host evidence
• Re-runs N4→N8 query cycle across merged telemetry
36 registered parser classes across 7 forensic categories
• Executed AFTER approved host story is established
• Drafts Sigma rules, KQL queries & Suricata signatures
• Direct export to SOC & SIEM detection repositories
CLI: nexus case detections (Actionable rule generation)
